screen.onboarding.title: Get started
screen.onboarding.lead: Three steps from a new organization to your first audio.
screen.onboarding.step1.title: Create an API key
screen.onboarding.step1.body: The key is shown once. Store it in your environment, not in code.
screen.onboarding.step2.title: Send a request
screen.onboarding.step2.body: Send a short Hindi, Hinglish, or English sentence to the speech endpoint.
screen.onboarding.step3.title: Hear the result
screen.onboarding.step3.body: Play the same sentence in the playground and listen to the first audio arrive.
screen.playground.title: Playground
screen.playground.lead: Type a sentence, choose a voice, and listen. The text stays in this page and is not stored.

screen.playground.zeroBalanceReason: Top up your balance to play audio.
screen.playground.overLimitReason: Shorten the text to fit the limit.

site.voicepage.title: Custom voice
site.voicepage.lead: A voice built from recordings you own or are licensed to use.
site.voicepage.s1: Request: tell us what the voice is for.
site.voicepage.s2: Consent and rights review: we check the speaker's consent and your rights to the recordings.
site.voicepage.s3: Recording guide: we send a recording specification and a script.
site.voicepage.s4: Build and review: we build the voice and you listen before it goes live.
site.voicepage.s5: Delivery: the voice appears in your account.
site.voicepage.requirementsBody: A signed consent form from every speaker, and recordings that meet the recording specification.
site.voicepage.notAcceptedBody: Voices of people who have not consented. We do not build a voice from audio found elsewhere.
site.voicepage.price: Lead time and price: quoted per request.
site.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
site.faq.a1: Each Unicode code point of the text you send is one character, after NFC normalisation and before any reading rules are applied. Spaces and punctuation count.
site.faq.q2: Does Yuyin read my text aloud to others?
site.faq.a2: No. Your text is used to produce your audio. The Privacy Policy describes what is stored.
site.faq.q3: What happens when capacity is full?
site.faq.a3: The service says so with an error and a retry hint instead of slowing down silently.
site.faq.q4: Can I run it in my own data centre?
site.faq.a4: Yes. The self-host edition runs on your hardware under a licence. Contact us to discuss it.
site.faq.a5: Hindi, Hinglish, and English, including sentences that mix Devanagari and Latin script.
site.faq.q6: How do I get an account?
site.faq.a6: Accounts are created by a Yuyin operator. Contact us and we will set one up.
site.about.title: About Yuyin
site.about.lead: What we are building and why.
site.about.what: Yuyin is a streaming text-to-speech service. It begins speaking while the sentence is still arriving, so a voice agent or an alert does not wait for the whole message.
site.about.why: Why Hindi, Hinglish, and English together: people write and speak them in the same sentence, so a voice that handles only one at a time reads real messages badly.
site.about.name: The name: yuyin is the Mandarin word for speech.
site.about.company: Yuyin is a product of Serverless Ventures LLC.
